items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Rowland was around 42, around 40 and 41. Around 40? Around 39 and 40. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, somewhere around there.

ctx.x: That was a pro-roar. Oh, yeah. That was around 40. Rowland was around 42, around 40 and 41. Around 40? Around 39 and 40.

Yeah, somewhere around there. 38 to 39. And another little fella used to give me a hand, his name was Father Toots. He's still around somewhere around here. Around Jefferson, C.S.B.R. or Seasbury someplace. He's good too.
